major_findings.summary: Invented brown-butter dependency and split into the pear-caramelizing branch
major_findings.evidence: The original caramelize-pears operation has only pears as input, while the candidate adds out-brown-butter and routes the same brown-butter output to both caramelize-pears and whisk-custard.

rationale: Most text and conditions are accurately retained, but the candidate changes the recipe graph and material use by introducing an unsupported brown-butter split into the pear branch.
